title: Survive
intro: Vim has modes. In Normal mode keys are commands. In Insert mode keys type text. Esc always takes you back to Normal mode. In any level, :q and Enter take you back to this list and :e! starts the level over.

levels.title: Get out
levels.brief: You are in Insert mode (see the badge at the top right). Press Esc to return to Normal mode. That is the whole level.
levels.hint: Esc is the most important key in Vim. When in doubt, press it.

levels.title: Say hi
levels.brief: The buffer is empty. Press i to enter Insert mode, type hi, then press Esc.
levels.hint: i inserts before the cursor. Everything you type until Esc goes into the text.

levels.title: Finish the word
levels.brief: The cursor is on the last letter. i would insert before it. Use a to append after the cursor, type or, then Esc.
levels.hint: a is i shifted one character to the right.

levels.title: Capital
levels.brief: Add an exclamation mark at the end of the line. A appends at the end of the line no matter where the cursor is.
levels.hint: Capital A means append at the end of the line.

levels.title: Save and quit
levels.brief: Nothing to change here. Type :wq and press Enter. In Vim that writes the file and quits; here it submits the level.
levels.hint: The colon opens the command line at the bottom. w is write, q is quit.

levels.title: Fix and save
levels.brief: Add a full stop at the end, then :wq to submit.
levels.hint: Esc first. The colon only works in Normal mode.

levels.title: Keep typing
levels.brief: You are already in Insert mode at the end of the line. Type a space and sat, then Esc.
levels.hint: Check the mode badge before you type.
